title: What a verified badge on BulkSkart checks
body: Demo post: The green check means a BulkSkart admin checked the GSTIN, CIN or Udyam number on the official portal. Ask the supplier for a GOTS certificate if you need organic cotton. Post your requirement at bulkskart.com/post-requirement
